body:
How much validation coverage is lost through test recognition, command selection and output parsing? Follow-up to #28.

**Current findings:** A predeclared six-PR SAMtools sample contains four PRs adding net Perl test invocations; the pinned recognizer counts zero for all six. All test-path sets agree with retained descriptors, but current diff bytes are not claimed identical to original unretained diffs. SGR normalization now passes the same 12 explicit fixtures in both the native parser and exported standalone verifier; two targeting checks reproduce preservation of MNE’s broad path.

**New live targeting evidence:** #30 reproduced Matchms PR958 targeting two test files deleted by its patch; both delivered stages collect zero tests. No per-PR repair was applied. [Diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4862b97e/experiments/30-script-transport/live-diagnosis.json).

**Remaining work:** Next: evaluate general runner/targeting changes and complete execution checks before live recovery claims. Seven synthetic validation cases show the pinned validator accepting six incomplete/error cases; a candidate completion guard rejects them while preserving the complete pair. This is mechanism evidence, not regrading of original tasks.

**Boundaries:** original baselines remain immutable; use only justified general changes and upstream’s built-in model calls, with no added per-task LLM/Codex repair loop. No remote/native jobs or model calls have been launched in this follow-up. Execution requires a checkpointed cumulative allowance; #28’s unused ceiling is not a fresh budget. A mechanism test does not establish task recovery or production readiness.

[Evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d38f3e76bbfeba803fa42bc5a026d688ec0d873/experiments/32-runner-coverage/sample-findings.json) · [Full comparison scope and success criteria](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d38f3e76bbfeba803fa42bc5a026d688ec0d873/experiments/32-runner-coverage/issue-scope.md) · [Logbook](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d38f3e76bbfeba803fa42bc5a026d688ec0d873/experiments/32-runner-coverage/logbook.md). Detailed investigation updates are in comments.

🤖 Initial investigation is published on the permanent research branch at `0a875d9c899e4a1c4015c1e1ce47c96711ee1745`.

A predeclared six-PR SAMtools sample contains four PRs adding net Perl test invocations; the pinned recognizer counts zero for all six. All test-path sets agree with retained descriptors, but current diff bytes are not claimed identical to original unretained diffs. SGR normalization passes 12 explicit parser fixtures; two targeting checks reproduce preservation of MNE’s broad path.

Parser normalization alone is insufficient: partial timed-out logs can still contain apparent failure-to-pass transitions. The completion comparison uses exact native logic with synthetic executor outcomes and the real pinned pytest parser. Original rewards remain untouched. Raw sampled diffs stay local because they contain biological fixtures; public findings contain source URLs, paths, refs and hashes only.

Next: evaluate general runner/targeting changes and complete execution checks before live recovery claims. Seven synthetic validation cases show the pinned validator accepting six incomplete/error cases; a candidate completion guard rejects them while preserving the complete pair. This is mechanism evidence, not regrading of original tasks.

[Evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0a875d9c899e4a1c4015c1e1ce47c96711ee1745/experiments/32-runner-coverage/sample-findings.json) · [Scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0a875d9c899e4a1c4015c1e1ce47c96711ee1745/experiments/32-runner-coverage/issue-scope.md) · [Logbook](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0a875d9c899e4a1c4015c1e1ce47c96711ee1745/experiments/32-runner-coverage/logbook.md). All changes remain research-only; no promotion to main, live task repair or model spend. The issue remains open.

🤖 The styling-normalization candidate now covers both the native pytest parser and the exported standalone verifier. A native-only change could recognize statuses during generation that the eventual task grader still misreads.

All 12 expected-status fixtures pass for both candidate parsers, including plain-output parity with the pinned baselines and colored-output agreement. Normalization strips only ANSI SGR styling; it does not change test IDs, broaden terminal control handling, or prove that a test command finished. The separate completion guard and live comparisons remain required. No original task was regraded, and no model calls or remote jobs were launched for #32.

[Exact fixture results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d38f3e76bbfeba803fa42bc5a026d688ec0d873/experiments/32-runner-coverage/parser-results.json), [exported-parser patch](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d38f3e76bbfeba803fa42bc5a026d688ec0d873/experiments/32-runner-coverage/sgr-export-parser.patch), [native-parser patch](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d38f3e76bbfeba803fa42bc5a026d688ec0d873/experiments/32-runner-coverage/sgr-parser.patch).

🤖 A live #30 comparison exposed another upstream targeting failure: Matchms PR958 deletes two test files, but the unchanged targeting function includes both deleted paths in the pytest command. Both pre/post stages report a missing test path and collect zero tests. The transport candidate removes errno7 but cannot produce F2P tests under that command.

The frozen patch and actual stdout hashes are bound in [the diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4862b97e/experiments/30-script-transport/live-diagnosis.json). No per-PR test repair was applied. This is a concrete case for a general diff-aware target-selection comparison under this issue, separate from color parsing and timeout completion checks. Removing deleted targets may expose further failures; recovery is not assumed.
